poison_arrow.name: Poison Arrow
poison_arrow.description: A green-stained arrow that leaves venom in the wound.
poison_arrow.telegraph: The goblin nocks a green-stained arrow.

bone_volley.name: Bone Volley
bone_volley.description: A clatter of sharpened bone shards.
bone_volley.telegraph: The skeleton rattles and raises a fistful of bone shards.

savage_bite.name: Savage Bite
savage_bite.description: A tearing bite that feeds the beast.
savage_bite.telegraph: The wolf lowers its head and snarls.

dark_bolt.name: Dark Bolt
dark_bolt.description: A lance of cold, whispered power.
dark_bolt.telegraph: The cultist's voice drops to a whisper.

spectral_touch.name: Spectral Touch
spectral_touch.description: A numbing touch from beyond the grave.
spectral_touch.telegraph: The specter's outline thins and reaches toward you.

cheap_shot.name: Cheap Shot
cheap_shot.description: A quick jab at an exposed opening.
cheap_shot.telegraph: The bandit feints and looks for an opening.

blinding_powder.name: Blinding Powder
blinding_powder.description: A fistful of caustic dust thrown into the eyes.
blinding_powder.telegraph: The bandit reaches into a pouch and hurls a handful of dust.

web_shot.name: Sticky Web
web_shot.description: A mass of silk pins the target in place.
web_shot.telegraph: The giant spider gathers a bundle of webbing under its abdomen.

silver_tongue.name: Silver Tongue
silver_tongue.description: A honeyed command that makes the target reluctant to strike back.
silver_tongue.telegraph: The Smuggler Lord smiles and speaks a few soft, measured words.

hex_bolt.name: Hex Bolt
hex_bolt.description: A knot of cursing light that bursts across the eyes.
hex_bolt.telegraph: The goblin hexer traces a jagged sign in the air.

reckless_cleave.name: Reckless Cleave
reckless_cleave.description: A wild two-handed cut that leaves both fighter and target off balance.
reckless_cleave.telegraph: The berserker drags both axes back for a wide, reckless swing.

grave_guard.name: Grave Guard
grave_guard.description: The champion raises a dead shield, warding itself as the grave-chill bites.
grave_guard.telegraph: The Risen Champion plants its rusted blade and raises a dead shield.

shield_bash.name: Shield Bash
shield_bash.description: A crushing blow that leaves the sentinel braced.
shield_bash.telegraph: The Iron Sentinel locks its shield forward.

repair.name: Repair
repair.description: Runes knit the sentinel's plates back together.
repair.telegraph: The Iron Sentinel's runes flicker to life.

dirty_trick.name: Dirty Trick
dirty_trick.description: A pocketful of stinging powder and a low blow.
dirty_trick.telegraph: Vargas reaches into his coat with a thin smile.

flame_breath.name: Flame Breath
flame_breath.description: A cone of red fire that leaves the target burning.
flame_breath.telegraph: The young dragon draws a deep, glowing breath.

rune_lash.name: Rune Lash
rune_lash.description: A whip of searing rune-light cuts across the hall.
rune_lash.telegraph: The rune sentinel's core brightens and its spear splits the air.

rune_pulse.name: Rune Pulse
rune_pulse.description: A wave of force erupts from the Warden's chest.
rune_pulse.telegraph: The Rune Warden's chest-plate opens like a furnace door.

warding_light.name: Warding Light
warding_light.description: Runic light crawls over the Warden's broken plates.
warding_light.telegraph: The Rune Warden plants its blade and the runes flare.

gravity_well.name: Gravity Well
gravity_well.description: The sanctum's ward crushes the air around you.
gravity_well.telegraph: The Rune Warden raises one hand and the floor groans.
